title: How deep can ectomycorrhizas go? A case study on Pisolithus down to 4 meters in a Brazilian eucalypt plantation.
authors: Robin, A., Pradier, C., Sanguin, H., Mahé, F., Lambais, G.R., de Araujo Pereira, A.P., Germon, A., Santana, M.C., Tisseyre, P., Pablo, A.-L., Heuillard, P., Sauvadet, M., Bouillet, J.-P., Andreote, F.D., Plassard, C., de Moraes Gonçalves, J.L., Cardoso, E.J.B.N., Laclau, J.-P., Hinsinger, P. and Jourdan, C.
sampling_info: A 1.5-m square pit was dug in the center of the 3-m-wide inter-row of plot, between four neighbor trees. Fine roots (< 2 mm) were very carefully and manually sampled, and were washed with tap water and stored at - 20 °C until analysis.
sample_info: The trees were 5 years old with a mean tree height of 20 m and a root front depth down to 17 m. Fertilization treatment used (non-limiting for tree growth) representative of the silvicultural practices in commercial eucalypt plantations (12 gN m-2,3.3gPm-2,17.5gKm-2,200gm-2 ofdolomitic lime and trace elements applied the first 3 months after planting). Physiochemical data come from soil samples from Pradier et al. 2017 (https://doi.org/10.1007/s11104-016-3107-7). P: P extracted with an anion exchange resin, K: K extracted with a cation exchange resin. Humidity (%) = 8.59
location: Itatinga research station of the University of Sao Paulo

location: Itatinga research station of the University of Sao Paulo

sampling_info: A 1.5-m square pit was dug in the center of the 3-m-wide inter-row of plot, between four neighbor trees. Fine roots (< 2 mm) were very carefully and manually sampled, and were washed with tap water and stored at - 20 °C until analysis.
sample_info: The trees were 5 years old with a mean tree height of 20 m and a root front depth down to 17 m. Fertilization treatment used (non-limiting for tree growth) representative of the silvicultural practices in commercial eucalypt plantations (12 gN m-2,3.3gPm-2,17.5gKm-2,200gm-2 ofdolomitic lime and trace elements applied the first 3 months after planting). Physiochemical data come from soil samples from Pradier et al. 2017 (https://doi.org/10.1007/s11104-016-3107-7). P: P extracted with an anion exchange resin, K: K extracted with a cation exchange resin. Humidity (%) = 12.9
location: Itatinga research station of the University of Sao Paulo
